metadata.description: [SUPERSEDED FOR v6 2026-07-22 -- describes the v5 design; see v6_freegrav_redesign_2026_07_22. In v6: CMR2 is NOT an observable; gravity is agnostic (widened dC20_nh/dC22_nh boxes -> ~zero interior C/MR2 info); 11 sampled parameters; gravity is conditioned on REAL GC21 SOL-A data, not a synthetic hydrostatic null.] Europa Clipper v4 geodesy campaign: v3 8D (rheology + Tb_K + log10_wOcean_ppt salinity + sampled core, mass-conservation rho_sil) PLUS Mazarico-projected degree-2 gravity. Adds two sampled non-hydrostatic offsets dC20_nh, dC22_nh (uniform [-2e-5, 2e-5]) => 10 sampled parameters. k2 conditioning tightened to the Mazarico et al. (2023) projected precision (Re_k2 0.23+/-0.015, Im_k2 0.0040+/-0.015) replacing v1-v3's requirement-level sigma 0.06. CMR2 is RETAINED but RELABELED as a Galileo-derived MoI PRIOR (GC21 Table 3), not a Clipper observable. C20/C22 modeled directly via a hydrostatic Clairaut forward map (gravity_forward_model='clairaut_hydrostatic') + sampled non-hydrostatic offsets; the posterior of (dC20_nh, dC22_nh) IS the inferred degree of non-hydrostaticity. Same 2D (Tb x w) v3.0 structure cache (NO PP runs). Plan: plans/europa-clipper-v4-geodesy-plan.md.
metadata.gravity_forward_model_2026_07_19: [SUPERSEDED FOR v6 2026-07-22 -- describes the v5 design; see v6_freegrav_redesign_2026_07_22. In v6: CMR2 is NOT an observable; gravity is agnostic (widened dC20_nh/dC22_nh boxes -> ~zero interior C/MR2 info); 11 sampled parameters; gravity is conditioned on REAL GC21 SOL-A data, not a synthetic hydrostatic null.] gravity_forward_model='clairaut_hydrostatic' (InferenceConfig top-level flag). The C20/C22 observables are COMPUTED per sample by MCMCRunner._derive_gravity_pair: fluid Love number k_f by direct Clairaut integration (gravity_obs.clairaut_kf) over the SAME per-sample composite density profile the CMR2 mass-conservation derivation assembles (sampled core + derived silicate + cached hydrosphere; side-channel _last_composite_layers so they cannot diverge), then C22_h = k_f q_r / 4 rescaled to the GC21 1565 km reference radius, C20_h = -3.324 C22_h (Tricarico 2014 rapid-rotation ratio; classical 10/3 in docstrings only), plus the sampled offsets: C20_model = C20_h + dC20_nh, C22_model = C22_h + dC22_nh. Clairaut (not Radau-Darwin) is used because the ~1% RD systematic (~1e-6 in C22 = 5x sigma(C22)) would alias into the non-hydrostaticity deliverable (scientific review R2, 2026-07-19). RD retained only as a unit-test cross-check and the GUI inverse readout.
metadata.gravity_convention_2026_07_19: UNNORMALIZED Stokes coefficients (Anderson et al. 1998 / Gomez Casajus et al. 2021 convention), quoted at the GC21 reference radius R_ref = 1565 km (NOT the physical R_body = 1560.8 km; Clm scale as (R/R_ref)^2, a ~0.5% effect on C22 = 3x sigma(C22), applied in gravity_obs.hydrostatic_c20_c22). Fully-normalized conversions: C20_unnorm = sqrt(5) C_bar20; C22_unnorm = sqrt(10/24) C_bar22 ~ 0.6455 C_bar22. Hydrostatic ratio J2_h/C22_h = 3.324 (Tricarico 2014, as applied by GC21), NOT the classical synchronous 10/3.

metadata.gravity_sigma_convention_risk_2026_07_19: sigma(C22) = 2.0e-7, sigma(C20) = 8.5e-7 (top of the Mazarico projected (3.5-8.5)e-7 range). Convention risk (USER ANSWER (a), 2026-07-19): if Table 5's sigma is 4-pi-normalized, unnorm sigma(C22) = 1.29e-7 (so 2.0e-7 is CONSERVATIVE) and unnorm sigma(C20) = 13.4e-7 (so 8.5e-7 carries a residual ~1.6x too-tight risk, documented). metadata.k2_provenance_2026_07_19: Re_k2 = 0.23 +/- 0.015, Im_k2 = 0.0040 +/- 0.015 (USER 2026-07-19, Mazarico et al. 2023 SSRv 219:30 sec 3.1.1). Central Re_k2 = 0.23 is the ocean-consistent value (Moore & Schubert 2000: 'around 0.23 with an ocean and <0.015 without'); sigma = 0.015 is the mid of the projected (1.4-1.8)e-2 49-flyby precision, REPLACING v1-v3's requirement-level sigma 0.06. metadata.zeta_split_2026_07_19: log10_zeta split into log10_zeta_Ih (ice Ih) and log10_zeta_sil (silicate), both U[-3, 2] (user 2026-07-19): a SINGLE sampled zeta couples the Andrade transient-creep amplification of ice and rock, so any zeta raised to fit ice dissipation (Im k2) simultaneously amplifies silicate dissipation - systematically preferencing silicate heating in the posterior heating budget. Independent zetas let the data set each. No HP-ice zeta: the Europa Tb box has no III/V/VI layers. metadata.reparameterization_2026_07_20: v5 replaces the uniform Tb_K prior with an informative prior on ICE-SHELL THICKNESS D_iceIh_km (truncated Gaussian mu=29, sigma=10 km, trunc [5,60]); Tb becomes a derived quantity via a per-salinity monotone (PCHIP) inversion D_iceIh,w -> Tb on this 2D cache. Rationale (scientific-reviewer, 2026-07-20): a uniform Tb box is an implicit, strongly salinity-dependent ice-thickness prior (Phase-0 measured warm-edge ice 22.5 km @0.1ppt vs 0.46 km @100ppt) that contaminates the Tb<->w degeneracy deliverable. Placing the prior on D_iceIh makes the ice-thickness prior salinity-independent. This config still lists Tb_K in param_space for the CACHE BUILD (build_phase_c1_cache reads Tb_K.bounds); Phase 2 swaps param_space Tb_K -> D_iceIh_km for the sampled space. Warm edge extended 271.0 -> 272.5 K so 10 km ice is reachable at low salinity (needs Tb up to 272.29 K per Phase 0); per-column nodes past Tmelt(P_base,w) build to None and are excluded by the inversion edge rejection.

metadata.open_interpretation_redesign_2026_07_21: USER-DIRECTED PIVOT (2026-07-21): train a BROAD, open 'Europa-Clipper-alone' artifact; impose literature constraints (Levin 2025 ice thickness; tight Vance/Galileo induction) as SEPARABLE inference-time reweights on the ONE artifact. TWO changes: (1) D_iceIh_km prior truncated_gaussian(29,10,[5,60]) -> UNIFORM[5,80] km. PP D_iceIh = TOTAL Ih shell (models solid-state convection); Levin 29+/-10 km (papers/levin2025europa.pdf, DOI 10.1038/s41550-025-02718-0) is CONDUCTIVE-lid thickness, so a direct N(29,10) reweight on the TOTAL D_iceIh would be physically WRONG (forbids a convecting sublayer) - build a convection-aware conductive->total construction at inference time. Uniform[5,80] is the maximally-agnostic base measure, evenly covers the 45-70 km likelihood-favored region (was 5.4% -> 33% of prior mass), removes the load-bearing 60 km truncation (profile-LL was still rising at 60), and CURES the v5-baseline training-density starvation (old prior put only ~1.4% of mass within +/-2 km of the 51 km reference mode). Upper 80 km: physically << Ih->HP transition (100 km ~120 MPa basal, transition ~210 MPa/~155 km) and <= cache D_max(w) at posterior salinities (16-33 ppt -> D_max~100 km); high-salinity columns have D_max<80 (66 km @100 ppt) so near-80 km draws edge-reject there - report residual per-w truncation in the gate. (2) induction_bounds made PER-FREQUENCY in the complex-Ae basis with a degree-based phase cap (Vance et al. 2021 Fig 6/Table 2): synodic + synodic-2nd |Ae|>0.7/phase<30 deg; orbital |Ae|>0.3/phase<70 deg (low-salinity thick-ice models legitimately reach orbital |Ae|~0.37, phase~65 deg - a single synodic-style 0.7/0.4 cut would wrongly clip them). Replaces the |Im| proxy (im_abs_max) with phase_deg_max (amplitude-independent). The tight literature induction band (synodic 0.92-0.97, <1 deg) folds in as an inference-time reweight, same as Levin. k2-convention question (min reachable Re_k2=0.241 > 0.23 target) is ROBUST to this training design (broad prior commits to no interpretation) but remains a mandatory gate on the SCIENCE CLAIM. Scientific-reviewer a41db4adc1e7f239e: PASS WITH CONCERNS. Fiducial conditioning + cache/sidecar hashes UNCHANGED (external conditioning, not prior-derived).

metadata.v6_freegrav_redesign_2026_07_22: USER-DIRECTED (2026-07-22): eliminate the geodesy double-count. v5 imposed CMR2=[0.3547,0.0024] as a TIGHT independent observable AT THE SAME TIME as tight C20/C22 -- but 0.3547 was itself derived FROM C22 via the hydrostatic Radau relation (GC21 Table 3), so the same physical relation was used twice, biasing the posterior toward hydrostaticity (the very quantity the campaign measures). v6 fix: (1) CMR2 REMOVED from observables (no longer a likelihood term); (2) C20/C22 set to GC21 Table 2 SOL-A UNCONSTRAINED (J2=437.59+/-77.47, C22=138.62+/-2.44, x1e-6, UNNORMALIZED at R_ref=1565 km -- NO sqrt(5)/sqrt(10/24) conversion per reviewer block-level correction, since Table 2 is already unnormalized). SOL-A -C20/C22 = 3.157 (NOT the hydrostatic Tricarico 3.324): the unconstrained solution does not obey the hydrostatic ratio -- that ~0.3-sigma gap IS the (statistically insignificant) non-hydrostatic signal, consistent with GC21's own J2/C22=3.16+/-0.57. RD hydrostatic-reference C/MR2 from SOL-A C22 = 0.3559 (consistent with the v5 fiducial 0.3550). (3) BOTH non-hydrostatic offset boxes widened so gravity carries ~ZERO interior C/MR2 info (USER 'truly agnostic', resolving reviewer MAJOR finding): dC20_nh [-2e-5,2e-5]->[-3.9e-4,3.9e-4] (~5*sigma(C20)); dC22_nh [-2e-5,2e-5]->[-5e-5,5e-5]. The narrow v5 dC22_nh + tight C22 silently boxed interior C/MR2 to ~[0.335,0.373] centered on the hydrostatic reference (a residual hydrostaticity-centered MoI constraint); +/-5e-5 lets C/MR2 span ~[0.30,0.40] freely. The old 'sigma(C22) tiny' rationale conflated C22 measurement precision with the prior width on the physical non-hydrostatic C22 anomaly. CONSEQUENCE: the published HYDROSTATIC C/MR2 (GC21 0.3547+/-0.0024) is NO LONGER an observable; it returns ONLY as the OPTIONAL inference-time reweight on the derived hydrostatic-reference C/MR2 (plan task D), which is therefore REQUIRED before any science claim on the interior C/MR2 (D is inference-time, needs no retraining). The PRIMARY non-hydrostaticity deliverable is UNAFFECTED by the box widening: the identifiable combination dC20_nh + 3.324*dC22_nh is interior-independent (C22_h cancels), central estimate unbiased. Dual C/MR2 deliverable: hydrostatic-reference (RD from C22) vs actual (structure integral); gap = non-hydrostaticity. Plan: fluffy-snacking-fountain. Interior priors, 2D (Tb x w) cache, rheology, induction bounds, and k2/h2 conditioning are BYTE-IDENTICAL to v5; only the gravity channel + the two offset-box widths changed.
metadata.v6_hybrid_conditioning_2026_07_22: DESIGN NOTE (reviewer MODERATE): v6 conditions the GRAVITY channel (C20/C22) on REAL Galileo-era data (GC21 SOL-A, ratio 3.157), while k2/h2 and the 14 Bind_ induction channels remain the v5 SYNTHETIC fiducial forecast (Re_k2=0.23 Mazarico projection; Bind from the Tb=264.5 K / w=35.165 ppt / R_core=534.67 km fiducial interior). v6 is therefore a real-gravity + forecast-tidal/induction HYBRID, NOT the v5 self-consistent hydrostatic NULL. Verified mutually consistent: the fiducial interior's C22_h=1.3775e-4 sits 0.36 sigma from real SOL-A C22=1.3862e-4, and fiducial C/MR2~=0.355 ~= SOL-A hydrostatic-reference 0.356, so the hybrid does not manufacture tension.
